name: Ise Saburou
source:
A warrior from the late Heian period. She is one of Yoshitsune's Four Heavenly Kings. Her father was a retainer of the Genji clan, but he passed away from illness along with her mother. She is naturally gentle, the type who wouldn't hurt a fly, but when she puts on her mask, her personality shifts and she becomes bold and aggressive.
